segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser removes excess oil without over-stripping for most, though one warns it is not recommended for oily skin and another found the texture hard to wash off.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin consistently report hydration without stripping or tightness, though one reviewer says it dried her skin out and did nothing for acne.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mixed results, from a holy-grail cleanser that clears acne and hyperpigmentation to a case that triggered breakouts and dryness in someone with rosacea in the family.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin generally describe it as gentle and non-irritating, calming eczema, rosacea, and perioral dermatitis, though a couple mention slight stinging or burning.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or older report softer skin, diminished age marks, and no breakouts.

concerns.aging: Reviewers in their 60s-40s report softer skin and diminished age marks with continued use; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe increased hydration and no tightness or flaking after use; a minority report the opposite, saying it stripped their skin and left it very dry.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report calmed redness and irritation linked to rosacea and eczema; no dissenting reports of increased redness found.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as helping rebuild or protect the skin barrier, especially when combined with hydrating moisturizer routines, with no reports of barrier damage.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports hyperpigmentation improved when paired with a hydrating moisturizer; this is a single account, not corroborated elsewhere.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including those with acne-prone or combination skin, report fewer breakouts or none at all; however, multiple reviewers report the opposite, describing new breakouts or worsened acne after use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report reduced oiliness without stripping, but one explicitly warns the product is not suited for oily skin and describes a heavy, hard-to-remove residue.

extraits.titre: Wish I read the reviews first
extraits.texte: I've had nothing but good experiences with Cerave until I used this facial cleanser, so I just want to make it clear that this review has nothing to do with Cerave on a more generalized scale. This solution was incompatible with my skin (combo skin; rosacea does run in the family), so that's the only reason why it's getting one star. To me, this Cerave product is just an outlier. Other than this one-off less than mediocre cleanser, Cerave is an excellent, dependable brand. I used this facial cleanser for a little under a week and noticed my face started breaking out and was getting dry. So I just switched back to the Cerave green facial cleanser, which is my go to. The one star reviews about people with combo skin breaking out after using this product are not lying.

extraits.titre: Did nothing but dry my skin out
extraits.texte: Stripped way too much of the oils from my skin, right after I wash it off my face is SO dry. Doesn't even help with acne. I guess the only positive thing about it is that it didn't break me out, or did it? I have no clue..

extraits.titre: Great for dry skin, oily skin beware
extraits.texte: Helps to rebuild the barrier if you're inflamed and dry. Leaves my skin feeling clean and hydrated, not stripped. Would not recommend for oily skin. If you're on any med that dries out your skin, this is a must have.

I have dry, sensitive, and mature skin and know I need a hydrating face cleanser and have used samples of this before and didn't like it at all. I've used cream to foam and foaming cleansers without success. Always ended up with irritation and redness, never understanding why which caused me to become frustrated. I did some research on why hydrating lotion type cleansers are good for my skin type and why there was a residue left behind. It was my fault! I didn't rub the cleanser between my hands or have a very wet face or rinse enough times. Since I do these steps now, man, what a game changer for my face!!!!!! No redness or irritation just softness and happiness. This is a MUST have for me.

extraits.titre: Amazing for my sensitive dry skin on acne ointments
extraits.texte: I used to use La Roche Posays Hydrating cleanser and felt like there eas no endin sight to my severely dry and irritated skin. I switched cleansers and havent looked back. It hydrates my skin and doesnt feel like its stripped it of all its moisture compared to the other brands. Love it!!!

extraits.titre: Baby skin soft and no more breakouts
extraits.texte: I have oily skin and am in my 40s. This product has left my skin feeling super soft and smooth, and my breakouts are nonexistent now. It's affordable and works great.

extraits.titre: Love it for my oily, sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: First of all, I love the foaming, cushiony texture—it lathers up on its own without needing much effort, which is super convenient. Since using this face wash daily, my skin feels less oily, and it doesn't strip away moisture at all. It's gentle yet effective, and I've noticed fewer breakouts, which is a big win for my acne-prone, sensitive skin. The only downside for me is the smell. Even though it says "no added fragrance," it kind of smells like buttered popcorn to me—not bad, just unexpected. I'm someone who prefers completely fragrance-free products, but I've gotten used to it and it doesn't bother me as much anymore. Overall, I highly recommend this for anyone with oily and sensitive skin. It's a great everyday cleanser!
